Name: Simon the Sorcerer
Summary: Simon the Sorcerer, also called Simon Magus, amazed Samaria with sorcery and claimed to be someone great. He believed and was baptised under Philip's preaching, then tried to buy the gift of the Holy Spirit from Peter and was sharply rebuked.
KeyStory: Simon offered money for the power of the Spirit and heard Peter say, Your money perish with you.
LifeLesson: Faith cannot be bought, and power is not a product. Simon's error still tempts every ministry that trades in gifts.
